There is no use of obfuscated code, unauthorized network requests, or dangerous runtime commands such as `curl | bash`.

No data exfiltration, unexpected file modifications, or execution of external scripts is present. The maintainer script logic is transparent and focused solely on repackaging the upstream binary in a manner suitable for Arch Linux. While the package uses prebuilt binaries (common for `-bin` packages), this is not a security issue in itself, especially when checksums are provided and match expected values.
</details>
